caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a saddle set against a plain, off-white background. The main body of the saddle is covered with a multicolored, intricate floral pattern, primarily featuring shades of green interspersed with red, pink, blue, and yellow flowers and leaves. The front and back of the saddle have darker sections, appearing almost black with brownish accents, while the bottom left side shows a smooth, tan leather part labeled with the number "255." The visible curved rim of the saddle is bordered with a decorative stitched or tooled edge. The artist's name "HARRY MAIRI WADDELL" is printed in uppercase letters to the right of the saddle, near the lower right corner of the image. The overall composition centers the saddle prominently on the page with no other objects present.
title: Side Saddle - California Syle
